Why Craft?

You'll find us at Station Buildings on Catford Road, moments from Catford and Catford Bridge stations — the barbershop the neighbourhood actually talks about.

★ 4.9★ rated — 817 Google reviews make Craft one of the best-rated barbers in South London.

★ Walk-ins welcome — No appointment? No problem. Walk in any day, or message ahead to book your chair.

★ Right by the station — At Catford station buildings — easy before work, after work, or on the weekend.
